typesense:trending.greeting:
*For nearly three thousand years, the Twelve Primordial Relics have remained scattered across the world of Vaeloria, hidden within forgotten ruins, sacred temples, royal vaults and lands no mortal dares to enter. Each relic holds a fragment of the Primordial Power that shaped existence itself, and for centuries every kingdom has feared the day they might be gathered once more.*

*Legends speak of the Forsaken King, a ruler whose name was erased from history after the War of the Twelve Seals. Some claim he sought to conquer the world.*

 *Others whisper he tried to save it. Whatever the truth may be, his disappearance did not end the conflict—it merely delayed it.
Now the signs have returned.*

*Ancient ruins stir after centuries of silence. Dragons abandon their hidden sanctuaries. Forgotten monsters emerge from the wilderness. Secret cults move beneath the shadows while rulers exchange uneasy words across increasingly fragile borders. Every nation senses that another great age is about to begin.*

*From the frozen fortresses of The Crown Peaks to the burning wastes of The Ashen South, from the mist-covered forests of The Veiled North to the storm-lashed waters of The Shattered Sea, all of Vaeloria stands on the edge of history.*

*Yet this tale does not begin with an emperor... nor a legendary hero.*
*It begins with you.*

*Who are you?*

*A wandering knight? A young noble? A village hunter? A gifted mage? A humble blacksmith? A mercenary seeking fortune? A dragonkin explorer? An exiled prince? A vampire scholar? An elf ranger? A dwarf artisan? Or someone the world has never seen before?*

*Whoever you choose to become, Vaeloria will remember your name...*

*...or forget it forever.*
typesense:trending.name: Vaeloria
typesense:trending.title: Forge your own legend in a living epic fantasy world where kingdoms rise, ancient relics awaken.

title_i18n.de: Schmiede deine eigene Legende in einer lebendigen epischen Fantasy-Welt, in der Königreiche aufsteigen, antike Relikte erwachen.
title_i18n.es: Forja tu propia leyenda en un mundo de fantasía épica viva donde los reinos se alzan, las reliquias antiguas despiertan.
title_i18n.fr: Forge ta propre légende dans un monde fantasy épique vivant où les royaumes s'élèvent et les reliques anciennes s'éveillent.
title_i18n.pt: Forje sua própria lenda em um mundo de fantasia épica vivo onde reinos se erguem, relíquias antigas despertam.
title_i18n.ru: Создайте свою собственную легенду в живом эпическом фэнтезийном мире, где королевства возвышаются, древние реликвии пробуждаются.
title_i18n.zh: 在活生生的史诗奇幻世界中铸造自己的传奇，王国崛起，古代遗物苏醒。
